3118763a.text: Ha! A tiny ship! This will be easy.

3dec912e.text: Bet you can't even find x!

7b1b1063.text: I polished my lasers just for you!

3c7b6cf7.text: Surrender now! Or later. Later works too.

bfc3d0af.text: Is that a ship or a flying toaster?

cec52952.text: Ignore him, pilot. Find x and fire!

fabd7afd.text: Rude! Let's show him some maths.

2e877c0f.text: Don't listen to him. You've got this!

51404b76.text: Ha! Missed me by a mile!

5f87f2be.text: My grandma aims better than that!

f5ac015d.text: Were you aiming at a comet?

5c7eec45.text: Nooo! Not my shiny paint job!

8d685ffe.text: Eject! EJECT! Where is the eject button?!

1fe63ed9.text: Okay, okay, you know your angles!

f601d707.text: My ship! I only just washed it!

975a3a6a.text: Too slow, pilot! Taking a nap?

d2037f59.text: Zzz... oh, are you done? Too late!

4ed4a305.text: Ha! Your ship is a space pancake now!

a29c3a1b.text: Boom! Better luck next time, pilot!

b5647a98.text: Who's the tiny ship now? Oh wait. Still you.

a32218ad.text: Who dares fly into MY sector?!

1d0502ea.text: Answer my angles... if you can! Mwahaha!

b6d48628.text: Wrong! The Warden is never wrong.

c753c01e.text: Mwahaha! My turrets are laughing at you!

35b07a02.text: Is that the best your school can teach?

41e03600.text: My turret! I just had it polished!

1360c92a.text: Stop that! Those cost a fortune!

8f7417e0.text: Ow! Not the core! Anything but the core!

7e380f6f.text: Grr! Stop doing maths at me!

49c7c7a1.text: Time's up! The Warden always wins!

919df25b.text: Too slow! My sector, my rules!

2b3b8949.text: Bow before the Warden! ...Or what is left of you.

82bee507.text: Hull breached! Dodge the rocks or shoot them first.

03129e25.text: Steer with ◀ ▲ ▼ ▶ and shoot the rocks and space junk!

9d27ecc5.text: Then fly through the portal to start Level 1.

7cdea476.text: Break its 4 turrets, then hit its core.

14d449a2.text: Raider incoming! It shoots at your ship.

a6fa4229.text: This bright line is your cannon.

e33dad76.text: Turn it by the angle x to hit the target.

a49d06e4.text: Meteor field! LOCK aims for you. SHIELD blocks hits.

5a91cd07.text: New rule: vertically opposite angles are equal.

96d34eb3.text: Rule: angles on a straight line add up to 180°.

2dc9e32b.text: New rule: a right angle makes 90°.

2fe596d8.text: New rule: angles around a point make 360°.

70ca9d01.text: New rule: a triangle's angles make 180°.

134819e4.text: Remember: Angles on a straight line add up to 180°. Try again!

c88bc06c.text: Remember: Vertically opposite angles are equal. Try again!

ca4af996.text: Remember: The two parts of a right angle add up to 90°. Try again!

a428f62e.text: Remember: Angles around a point add up to 360°. Try again!

1edf61bd.text: Remember: The angles in a triangle add up to 180°. Try again!

a605f55c.text: Tap the correct value of x!
